original: 愛は百人を愛すれば百分されるような量的なものではない。甲を愛しているから、乙を愛されないというのは真の愛ではない。

en.text: Love is not quantitative. If you love one hundred people, you cannot assign one hundredth of that love to each individual person. To say that you are not able to love one person because you love another is not real love.

original: 百、二百、三百、四百、五百、六百、七百、八百、九百、千。

en.text: One hundred, two hundred, three hundred, four hundred, five hundred, six hundred, seven hundred, eight hundred, nine hundred, one thousand.

original: これは二千四百六十八ドルです。

en.text: This is two thousand four hundred and sixty-eight dollars.

original: 九千二百五十八億一千四百七十万三千六百九十二は、十二桁の数字です。

en.text: Nine hundred twenty-five billion, eight hundred fourteen million, seven hundred three thousand, six hundred ninety-two is a twelve-digit number.

original: 百合は宿根草です。

en.text: Lilies are perennial plants.

original: 人口は、一万八千四百三十二人だった。

en.text: The population was 18,432.

original: 百均のイヤホンも思ったより使えるものがあります。

en.text: The dollar store earbuds worked better than I expected.
The earbuds from the 100-yen store worked better than I expected.

original: おもちゃの刀を持った少年が、お百度石に寄りかかっている。

en.text: A boy with a toy sword is leaning against the o-hyakudo-ishi, the stone of a hundredfold prayers.
A boy with a toy sword is leaning against the hundred-fold worship stone pillar.

original: この宝石は、ひとつ百万円以上のお値段です。

en.text: These jewels are priced at over a million yen each.
These gems are priced at over a million yen each.

original: 何百回と聞いてるよ。

en.text: You've told me that a hundred times.

original: 私の学校の図書館には、二百五十万冊もの蔵書があります。

en.text: My school library has a collection of 2.5 million books.

original: 家に来た年賀状は、三百枚ほどで、丁度、出した分と同じぐらいだ。

en.text: I received around 300 New Year's cards, just about as many as I had sent out.

original: この百合、すごくいい香りね。

en.text: These lilies smell lovely.
This lily smells really nice.
These lilies smell really good.
These lilies have a very nice smell.

original: トムが仕切りたがり屋なのは百も承知よ。

en.text: I'm well aware that Tom is a control freak.

original: 日本で百寿者がたくさんいますね。

en.text: There are a lot of centenarians living in Japan.
